title: ukrainian crispy sesame dish
description: a hearty one-pot dish from ukraine featuring crispy sesame seeds and a variety of wholesome ingredients. perfect as a comforting breakfast or lunch option.
instructions: in a large pot or Dutch oven, bring the water to a boil over high heat.
add the sorghum flour and stir to prevent lumps from forming.
reduce heat to medium-low and cook, covered, for 20 minutes, or until the mixture has thickened.
add the toasted sesame seeds, caraway seeds, salt, and black pepper. stir to combine.
add the chopped onion and cook for 5 minutes, or until softened.
add the garlic and cook for an additional 1-2 minutes.
add the buckwheat groats and spinach. stir to combine.
cover the pot and cook for an additional 10 minutes, or until the groats have absorbed most of the liquid and the spinach has wilted.
serve hot and garnish with additional sesame seeds if desired.
